_readme: Ministerial, parliamentary-secretary and deputy-minister appointments, with dates.
This file is HAND-CURATED on purpose. The Privy Council Office publishes ministry
lists and appointment Orders in Council, but not as a bulk file this pipeline can
fetch, and inventing appointment dates would silently corrupt every attribution
downstream. An empty roster is a supported state: role rows then report
'unmatched' and nothing is claimed about them.
Add one object per person per portfolio per interval:
{ "title": "Minister of Finance", "person_id": "<person_id from members-NN.json>",
"institution": "Department of Finance Canada",
"start_date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "end_date": null }
end_date null means 'still in post'. Overlapping intervals for the same office are
reported by `npm run offices` and make every communication in the overlap ambiguous.
person_id must match a person in data/out/members-NN.json, or the holding names a
chair with nobody in it.
'aliases' maps a portfolio phrase (French, or a renamed portfolio) onto a canonical
key, e.g. "ministre des ressources naturelles": "minister of natural resources".
Built-in aliases live in src/normalize/roles.mjs; add here what is specific to your
data rather than editing code.
Sources to transcribe from: PCO ministry list (canada.ca/en/privy-council), and the
Orders in Council search at orders-in-council.canada.ca for exact appointment dates.
